claims.claim: printk supports log levels and kernel logging; dynamic debug can selectively enable pr_debug/dev_dbg callsites.
claims.kind: kernel behavior, API or project documentation
claims.notes: Logging can perturb timing and increase overhead.

claims.claim: kdump uses a reserved capture kernel to preserve a crash dump for later analysis.
claims.kind: kernel behavior, API or project documentation
claims.notes: Requires configuration, memory reservation, dump target and matching symbols.

claims.claim: KASAN detects classes of memory safety errors including out-of-bounds and use-after-free.
claims.kind: kernel behavior, API or project documentation
claims.notes: Instrumentation changes memory layout and runtime overhead.

claims.claim: UBSAN detects selected undefined behavior conditions in instrumented kernel code.
claims.kind: kernel behavior, API or project documentation
claims.notes: Detection coverage depends on enabled checks and compiler support.

claims.claim: kgdb provides kernel source-level debugging through a GDB remote connection.
claims.kind: kernel behavior, API or project documentation
claims.notes: Requires suitable kernel configuration and a supported connection method.

claims.claim: KASAN 有 Generic、Software Tag-Based、Hardware Tag-Based 等实现；支持范围与开销依赖架构、编译器和内核配置，不能用固定 2–3 倍描述。
claims.notes: 需检查目标架构的 Kconfig 依赖。

claims.claim: kdump 依赖预留 crash kernel、转储目标和匹配的调试符号；crash 分析必须使用与 vmcore 对应的 vmlinux。
claims.notes: 转储采集应先在测试环境验证。

claims.claim: kgdboc 使用串口作为 KGDB I/O 通道；QEMU 串口 TCP 后端可用于隔离环境中的远程调试，但端口不应暴露到不可信网络。
claims.notes: Guest 串口、启动参数和 GDB 符号必须匹配。
